strings.lede: Sitshele okwenzekile ngokukhuluma noma ngokubhala. Sigcwalisa ifomu lasenkantolo nawe, umbuzo owodwa ngesikhathi. Kumahhala futhi kuyimfihlo.
strings.askDesc: Qonda imiyalelo yokuvikela, inqubo yasenkantolo namagama asemthethweni.
strings.fillDesc: Xoxa indaba yakho ngokubhala noma ngokukhuluma. Isicelo sakho sigcwaliswa njengoba ukhuluma.
strings.pv1: Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana lokho. Kwenzeka nini, uma ukhumbula?
strings.pv2: NgoLwesihlanu ebusuku, mhla zi-2. Cishe ngo-11.
strings.pv3: Ngiyabonga, lowo mniningwane usiza kakhulu inkantolo. Ingabe walimala?
strings.howSub: Omantshi badinga imininingwane ecacile ukuze banikeze umyalelo wokuvikela. I-inFORMed ikusiza ukuyinikeza, ngaphandle kokuthi ingxoxo izizwe njengefomu.
strings.s1d: Yabelana ngokwenzekile ngamazwi akho nangolimi lwakho. I-inFORMed ibuza umbuzo owodwa omnene ngesikhathi, futhi ungama noma nini.
strings.s2d: Yonke imininingwane ingena engxenyeni efanele yefomu lenkantolo, ibhalwe ngendlela omantshi abayidingayo: izinsuku, izindawo, okwashiwo, nokuthi izinto ziya ngokuba zimbi kanjani.
strings.s3d: Landa isicelo sakho njenge-PDF noma idokhumenti ye-Word, usiyise kumabhalane eNkantolo kaMantshi. Ungahlola futhi ushintshe noma yini kuqala.
strings.k1: Ungafaka isicelo somyalelo wokuvikela ngokwakho, mahhala, ngaphandle kommeli futhi ngaphandle kokuvula icala emaphoyiseni kuqala.
strings.k2: Ufaka isicelo eNkantolo kaMantshi lapho uhlala khona, usebenza noma ufunda khona, lapho omunye umuntu ehlala noma esebenza khona, noma lapho ukuhlukunyezwa kwenzeka khona.
strings.k2s: Izikhathi zenkantolo zivame ukuba ngu-9 ekuseni kuya ku-3:30 ntambama phakathi nesonto. Uma usengozini ungafaka isicelo ngemva kwalezo zikhathi.
strings.k3: Udlame lwasekhaya alukhona nje ukulimala komzimba. Lufaka ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzwelo, ngokwezimali nangokocansi, ukuhlukumeza, ukwesabisa nokulawula.
strings.k4: Izithombe, izincwadi zikadokotela noma ofakazi bangasiza, kodwa ungafaka isicelo nangaphandle kwazo. Ingane yanoma iyiphi iminyaka nayo ingafaka isicelo.
strings.aboutI1: I-inFORMed ithuluzi le-GRIT le-AI elisiza ezindabeni zomthetho. Ikhuluma njengelungu lomphakathi elinakekelayo, ayiphuthumi futhi ayahluleli, futhi isiza abantu ababhekene nodlame lwasekhaya ukufaka okwenzeka kubo esicelweni inkantolo engasisebenza.
strings.aboutI2: Iseluleko sayo sisekelwe efomini elisemthethweni lesicelo somyalelo wokuvikela, emihlahlandleleni mayelana namalungelo odlame lwasekhaya nokubhala isicelo esiqinile, ocwaningweni lwe-MOSAIC lokuthi omantshi babhekeni, nasemhlahlandleleni we-GRIT wemiyalelo yokuvikela.
strings.aboutG1: I-GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech) yinhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika yobuchwepheshe be-feminist esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukusekela abasinde odlameni olubhekiswe kubulili nokusiza abantu bathole ulwazi, usizo nezinsiza mayelana namalungelo abo, impilo nenhlalakahle.
strings.g1: Emsebenzini ogxile kubasindile nonakekela ukuhlukumezeka, lapho ukuphepha nezidingo zabasindile kusenhliziyweni yobuchwepheshe nezinhlelo zayo.
strings.g2: Ekwakheni ndawonye nemiphakathi, kuhlanganise abesifazane abasebasha, abasindile nabantu abanolwazi olusiza ukuklama amathuluzi.
strings.g3: Osizweni lwedijithali olufinyelelekayo, kuhlanganise uZuzi, ingxoxo esebenza nge-AI ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza lwe-GRIT, kanye nosizo lwe-WhatsApp namanye amathuluzi edijithali.
strings.g4: Ekufinyeleleni ukuphepha nosizo, kuhlanganise izici ezifana ne-Panic Button ne-Evidence Vault ohlelweni lokusebenza lwe-GRIT.
strings.hSadag: I-SADAG, usizo lwabacabanga ukuzibulala, amahora angu-24
strings.hTg: Xoxa ne-inFORMed, bhala noma uthumele imiyalezo yezwi

strings.guideAudio: Siyakwamukela ku-inFORMed, evela ku-GRIT. Le webhusayithi ikusiza ukugcwalisa ifomu lasenkantolo lomyalelo wokuvikela. Kumahhala futhi kuyimfihlo. Ukuze uqale, cindezela inkinobho enkulu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ethi: Qala ifomu lami. Bese uxoxa indaba yakho. Akudingeki ubhale. Cindezela imakrofoni bese ukhuluma, bese uyicindezela futhi uma usuqedile. Bese ucindezela ethi Yizwa ukuze ulalele lokho okuzwakele, bese ucindezela ethi Thumela uma kulungile, noma ethi Phinda ukusho. Uma uvula ethi Funda ngezwi, yonke impendulo izofundwa kuwe. Uma usengozini manje, shayela amaphoyisa ku-1 0 1 1 1, noma cindezela inkinobho ebomvu ethi Phuma ngokushesha phezulu ukuze uphume kule webhusayithi masinyane.
strings.hfIntro: Nasi isicelo sakho, sifundwa ngezwi. Yilokhu ozofunga ngakho enkantolo. Ungacindezela ethi Misa noma nini. Uma kukhona okungalungile noma okushodayo, ngitshele engxoxweni, noma ukushintshe efomini.
strings.hfIntroTr: Nasi isicelo sakho, sihunyushelwe esiZulwini ukuze usizwe. Ifomu uqobo lihlala ngesiNgisi, ngoba lifakwa enkantolo ngesiNgisi. Yilokhu ozofunga ngakho enkantolo. Ungacindezela ethi Misa noma nini. Uma kukhona okungalungile noma okushodayo, ngitshele engxoxweni.
strings.iP1: I-inFORMed iyi-AI chatbot eyenziwe yi-GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech). Ayiyena umuntu noma ummeli, futhi ayinikezi iseluleko somthetho. Ikusiza ukulungisa isalungiswa sefomu elisemthethweni lasenkantolo. Umabhalane eNkantolo kaMantshi ulihlola nawe ngaphambi kokuthi usayine.
strings.iP2: Ukuze ikuphendule, i-inFORMed ithumela imilayezo yakho ku-OpenAI, inkampani ene-AI esetshenziswayo. I-GRIT ayiyiboni futhi ayiyigcini imilayezo yakho. I-OpenAI icelwa ukuthi ingayigcini, futhi ayisetshenziselwa ukuqeqesha noma iyiphi i-AI.
strings.iP3: Ingxoxo ayigcinwa nhlobo: iyanyamalala uma uvala ikhasi. Ifomu lakho ligcinwa kule foni kuphela, ekhasini elivuliwe, ngakho ukulayisha kabusha ikhasi akulilahli. Uma ukhetha ethi “Londoloza ukuze uqedele kamuva”, likhiywa nge-PIN oyikhethayo futhi lihlala kule foni uze ulisuse. Akekho ongalivula ngaphandle kwe-PIN, ngisho ne-GRIT. I-PIN ekhohliwe ayikwazi ukutholakala.
strings.iP4: Cindezela ethi Qala kabusha noma Phuma ngokushesha ukuze usule ikhasi. Ukuze ususe ifomu eligciniwe, cindezela ethi “Qhubeka nesicelo esigciniwe” ekhasini lokuqala, faka i-PIN yakho bese ukhetha ethi “Lisuse”. Ifayela le-PDF noma le-Word olilandile lihlala kokulandiwe kwefoni yakho uze ulisuse.
strings.iP5: Omunye umuntu osebenzisa le foni angabona emlandweni wesiphequluli ukuthi uvakashele i-inFORMed, noma athole ifomu olilandile. Uma lokho kuyingozi, sebenzisa ithebhu eyimfihlo (incognito), susa okulandiwe ngemuva kokukusebenzisa, bese usula umlando wesiphequluli. Ifomu eligcinwe nge-PIN lihlala likhiyiwe. Ethebhu eyimfihlo, ifomu eligciniwe liyalahleka uma uvala ithebhu.
strings.iP6: Shayela amaphoyisa ku-10111 noma i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428. Zombili zimahhala. Ungasebenzisa ne-app ye-GRIT, enenkinobho yokuphuthuma ekuxhumanisa nosizo.

strings.bringNote: Ungafaka isicelo ngisho ungenazo lezi zinto. Phatha amakhophi bese ugcina okwangempela kuphephile.
strings.bringA1: Incwadi kamazisi noma iphasipoti yakho (noma yimuphi umazisi onawo)
strings.bringA2: Lesi sicelo, neFomu 6A (imininingwane yakho) ligcinwe lodwa
strings.bringA3: Konke okwaziyo ngaye: igama eligcwele, inombolo kamazisi, ikheli lasekhaya nelomsebenzi, inombolo yocingo, inombolo yemoto, isithombe
strings.bringA4: Noma yimiphi imiyalelo yokuvikela yangaphambili, izinombolo zamacala (CAS) noma ze-OB
strings.aS1: Yisa ifomu lakho kumabhalane kunoma iyiphi iNkantolo kaMantshi, ngezikhathi zenkantolo (imvamisa kusukela ngo-9 ekuseni kuya ku-3:30 ntambama ngezinsuku zomsebenzi). Uma usengozini, ungafaka isicelo nangemuva kwamahora omsebenzi. Kumahhala, futhi awudingi ummeli.
strings.aS2: Umabhalane ulihlola nawe. Ulisayina phambi kukakhomishana wezifungo.
strings.aS3: UMantshi uyalifunda, ngokuvamile ngalo lolo suku. Uma uMantshi ebona ukuthi udinga ukuvikelwa manje, ukunika umyalelo wokuvikela wesikhashana.
strings.aS4: Umyalelo wesikhashana unikezwa yena ngusherifu noma ngamaphoyisa. Ukuvikela kusukela ngesikhathi ewuthola.
strings.aS5: Unikezwa usuku lokubuyela enkantolo. Ngalolo suku nobabili ningeza enkantolo, futhi uMantshi unquma ukuthi uzowunikeza yini umyalelo wokuvikela wokugcina. Qiniseka ukuthi uya enkantolo ngalolo suku.
strings.aS6: Uma ephula umyalelo, kubike esiteshini samaphoyisa osibhale efomini lakho. Angaboshwa.
strings.aNo: UMantshi nguye onqumayo. Ukusebenzisa i-inFORMed akuqinisekisi ukuthi inkantolo izowunikeza umyalelo, noma ukuthi amaphoyisa azowuphoqelela.
strings.safety.support: Uma udinga ukukhuluma nomuntu manje, i-GBV Command Centre imahhala futhi ivulekile amahora angu-24: 0800 428 428. Ungabuye uthumele i-WhatsApp ku-GRIT ku-072 737 8819. Singama noma nini uma udinga.
